decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a sharp E-component offset near index 490 with partial recovery and cross-axis correlation, and (2) a coherent linear trend onset at index 725 across all axes, distinct from prior noise or motion.

regions.observation: Sharp ~10 MAD downward step in E-component at index ~490, followed by noisy recovery; N and U show correlated transient offsets but no clear platform. The step is abrupt (multi-sample) and not fully reversed within the window.

Linear trend in all three components from ~725 onward: N rises steadily, E drops steadily, U rises steadily—suggesting a possible sustained motion or systematic bias onset. The change begins abruptly at 725 and persists to end of record; surrounding samples (720–724) show no such trend, supporting a discrete onset.
